packages.name: Party room / event
packages.description: Party rooms and event options for birthdays, group gatherings and corporate events. Meeting rooms have computer screens and internet; the largest holds 48 people. Catering available.

packages.name: Bowling lane
packages.description: 24 bowling lanes, with bumpers and ramps available for young children.

faq.a: Bumpers and ramps are available for young children.
Kingpin Pizza is on site with stone oven pizzas, sandwiches, burgers and salads, plus a full sports bar and restaurant. Catering is available.

faq.q: What else is there besides bowling?
faq.a: A two-story laser tag arena, an arcade with over 70 games, a 16-foot kids' play structure, two bounce houses and outdoor mini golf (weather permitting).
Laser tag is for kids over 7, with up to 14 players at a time.

faq.q: Who can use the bounce houses?
faq.a: The bounce houses are for kids 7 and under.

faq.q: Do you offer school group discounts?
faq.a: Yes, school group discounts are available.
